records.arabic: حدثنا أحمد بن إسحاق السورماري قال حدثنا عبيد الله بن موسى قال حدثنا إسرائيل عن أبي إسحاق عن عمرو بن ميمون عن عبد الله قال بينما رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قائم يصلي عند الكعبة وجمع قريش في مجالسهم إذ قال قائل منهم ألا تنظرون إلى هذا المرائي أيكم يقوم إلى جزور آل فلان فيعمد إلى فرثها ودمها وسلاها فيجيء به ثم يمهله حتى إذا سجد وضعه بين كتفيه فانبعث أشقاهم فلما سجد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وضعه بين كتفيه وثبت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ساجدا فضحكوا حتى مال بعضهم إلى بعض من الضحك فانطلق منطلق إلى فاطمة عليها السلام وهي جويرية فأقبلت تسعى وثبت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ساجدا حتى ألقته عنه وأقبلت عليهم تسبهم فلما قضى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الصلاة قال اللهم عليك بقريش اللهم عليك بقريش اللهم عليك بقريش ثم سمى اللهم عليك بعمرو بن هشام وعتبة بن ربيعة وشيبة بن ربيعة والوليد بن عتبة وأمية بن خلف وعقبة بن أبي معيط وعمارة بن الوليد قال عبد الله فوالله لقد رأيتهم صرعى يوم بدر ثم سحبوا إلى القليب قليب بدر ثم قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأتبع أصحاب القليب لعنة بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
records.english: Ahmad ibn Ishaq al-Surammari related to us, saying: Ubayd Allah ibn Musa related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr ibn Maymun, from Abdullah, who said: While the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم stood praying by the Kabah, with a gathering of Quraysh in their meeting places, one of them said: “Will you not look at this show-off? Which of you will go to the slaughtered camel of such-and-such a family, take its stomach contents, blood, and fetal membrane, bring them, then wait until he prostrates and put them between his shoulders?” Their most wretched man sprang up. When the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم prostrated, he put it between his shoulders. Meanwhile, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم remained prostrate, and they laughed so hard that they leaned against one another with laughter. Someone went to Fatimah عليها السلام, who was a young girl. She came running. Meanwhile, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم remained prostrate until she threw it off him. She turned to them, reviling them. When the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم finished the prayer, he said: “O God, deal with Quraysh! O God, deal with Quraysh! O God, deal with Quraysh!” Then he named them: “O God, act against Amr ibn Hisham, Utbah ibn Rabiah, Shaybah ibn Rabiah, al-Walid ibn Utbah, Umayyah ibn Khalaf, Uqbah ibn Abi Muayt, and Umarah ibn al-Walid.” Abdullah said: Indeed, by God, I saw them lying slain on the day of Badr. They were then dragged to the well, the well of Badr. Then the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said, and followed the people of the well with a curse. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة قال قرأت على مالك عن بن شهاب أن عمر بن عبد العزيز أخر الصلاة يوما فدخل عليه عروة بن الزبير فأخبره أن المغيرة بن شعبة أخر الصلاة يوما وهو بالعراق فدخل عليه أبو مسعود الأنصاري فقال ما هذا يا مغيرة أليس قد علمت أن جبريل صلى الله عليه وسلم نزل فصلى فصلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم صلى فصلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم صلى فصلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم صلى فصلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم صلى فصلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم قال بهذا أمرت فقال عمر لعروة أعلم ما تحدث أو إن جبريل هو أقام لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وقت الصلاة قال عروة كذلك كان بشير بن أبي مسعود يحدث عن أبيه قال عروة ولقد حدثتني عائشة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يصلي العصر والشمس في حجرتها قبل أن تظهر
records.english: Abdullah ibn Maslamah related to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, that Umar ibn Abdulaziz delayed the prayer one day. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr came in to him and informed him that al-Mughirah ibn Shubah had delayed the prayer one day while he was in Iraq. Abu Masud al-Ansari came in to him and said, "What is this, O Mughirah? Did you not know that Gabriel صلى الله عليه وسلم descended and prayed, and the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed; then he prayed, and the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed; then he prayed, and the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed; then he prayed, and the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed; then he prayed, and the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed? Then he said, 'This is what I was commanded to do.'" Umar said to Urwah, "Know what you are relating! Or was it indeed Gabriel who established the time of prayer for the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم?" Urwah said, "That is how Bashir ibn Abi Masud used to relate it from his father." Urwah said, "Aishah also related to me that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم used to pray the afternoon prayer while the sun was in her chamber, before it rose out of it."

records.arabic: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد قال حدثنا عباد هو بن عباد عن أبي جمرة عن بن عباس قال قدم وفد عبد القيس على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالوا إنا من هذا الحي من ربيعة ولسنا نصل إليك إلا في الشهر الحرام فمرنا بشيء نأخذه عنك وندعو إليه من وراءنا فقال آمركم بأربع وأنهاكم عن أربع الإيمان بالله ثم فسرها لهم شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأني رسول الله وإقام الصلاة وإيتاء الزكاة وأن تؤدوا إلي خمس ما غنمتم وأنهى عن الدباء والحنتم والمقير والنقير
records.english: Qutaybah ibn Said related to us, saying: Abbad, who is Ibn Abbad, related to us, from Abu Jamrah, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The delegation of Abd al-Qays came to the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم and said, "We are from this clan of Rabiah, and we can reach you only in the sacred month. Command us something that we can take from you and call those behind us to." He said, "I command you four things and forbid you four: faith in God"—then he explained it to them—"testifying that there is no deity but God and that I am the Messenger of God, establishing prayer, giving the alms, and paying me a fifth of what you take as spoils. And I forbid gourds, green jars, pitch-coated vessels, and hollowed palm trunks."

records.arabic: حدثنا مسدد قال حدثنا يحيى عن الأعمش قال حدثني شقيق قال سمعت حذيفة قال كنا جلوسا عند عمر رضي الله عنه فقال أيكم يحفظ قول رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في الفتنة قلت أنا كما قاله قال إنك عليه أو عليها لجريء قلت فتنة الرجل في أهله وماله وولده وجاره تكفرها الصلاة والصوم والصدقة والأمر والنهي قال ليس هذا أريد ولكن الفتنة التي تموج كما يموج البحر قال ليس عليك منها بأس يا أمير المؤمنين إن بينك وبينها بابا مغلقا قال أيكسر أم يفتح قال يكسر قال إذا لا يغلق أبدا قلنا أكان عمر يعلم الباب قال نعم كما أن دون الغد الليلة إني حدثته بحديث ليس بالأغاليط فهبنا أن نسأل حذيفة فأمرنا مسروقا فسأله فقال الباب عمر
records.english: Musaddad related to us, saying: Yahya related to us, from al-Amash, who said: Shaqiq related to me, saying: I heard Hudhayfah say: We were sitting with Umar رضي الله عنه, and he said, "Which of you remembers the saying of the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم about the trial?" I said, "I do, just as he said it." He said, "You are certainly bold concerning it—or concerning the trial." I said, "A man's trial concerning his family, property, children, and neighbor is expiated by prayer, fasting, charity, commanding, and forbidding." He said, "That is not what I mean, but the trial that surges as the sea surges." The reply was, "You have nothing to fear from it, O Commander of the Faithful. Between you and it is a closed door." He said, "Will it be broken or opened?" The reply was, "Broken." He said, "Then it will never be closed." We said, "Did Umar know the door?" He said, "Yes, as surely as tonight comes before tomorrow. I related to him an account free of misleading puzzles." We were afraid to ask Hudhayfah, so we instructed Masruq, and he asked him. He said, "The door is Umar."

records.arabic: حدثنا قتيبة قال حدثنا يزيد بن زريع عن سليمان التيمي عن أبي عثمان النهدي عن بن مسعود أن رجلا أصاب من امرأة قبلة فأتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأخبره فأنزل الله وأقم الصلاة طرفي النهار وزلفا من الليل إن الحسنات يذهبن السيئات فقال الرجل يا رسول الله ألي هذا قال لجميع أمتي كلهم
records.english: Qutaybah related to us, saying: Yazid ibn Zuray related to us, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Abu Uthman al-Nahdi, from Ibn Masud: A man kissed a woman, then came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم and informed him. God then sent down, "Establish prayer at the two ends of the day and in the near hours of the night. Good deeds remove evil deeds." The man said, "O Messenger of God, is this for me?" He said, "For all my community, every one of them."

records.english: Abu al-Walid Hisham ibn Abdulmalik related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, saying: al-Walid ibn al-Ayzar informed me, saying: I heard Abu Amr al-Shaybani say: The owner of this house related to us—he pointed to Abdullah's house—saying: I asked the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, "Which deed is most beloved to God?" He said, "Prayer at its time." The question was, "Then which?" He said, "Then dutifulness to parents." The question was, "Then which?" He said, "Striving in the path of God." He related these to me, and had I asked him for more, he would have given me more.

records.english: Ibrahim ibn Hamzah related to us, saying: Ibn Abi Hazim and al-Darawardi related to me, from Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah ibn Abdurrahman, from Abu Hurayrah, who heard the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم say, "Consider: if there were a river at the door of one of you in which he washed five times every day, what would you say? Would that leave any of his dirt?" They said, "It would leave none of his dirt." He said, "That is the likeness of the five prayers: God erases sins through them."

records.english: Musa ibn Ismail related to us, saying: Mahdi related to us, from Ghaylan, from Anas, who said, "I recognize nothing of what existed in the time of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم." It was said, "Prayer?" He said, "Have you not neglected what you have neglected in it?"

records.arabic: حدثنا عمرو بن زرارة قال أخبرنا عبد الواحد بن واصل أبو عبيدة الحداد عن عثمان بن أبي رواد أخي عبد العزيز قال سمعت الزهري يقول دخلت على أنس بن مالك بدمشق وهو يبكي فقلت ما يبكيك فقال لا أعرف شيئا مما أدركت إلا هذه الصلاة وهذه الصلاة قد ضيعت وقال بكر حدثنا محمد بن بكر البرساني أخبرنا عثمان بن أبي رواد نحوه
records.english: Amr ibn Zurarah related to us, saying: Abdulwahid ibn Wasil, Abu Ubaydah al-Haddad, informed us, from Uthman ibn Abi Rawwad, the brother of Abdulaziz, who said: I heard al-Zuhri say: I went in to Anas ibn Malik in Damascus while he was weeping. I said, "What makes you weep?" He said, "I recognize nothing of what I knew except this prayer, and this prayer has been neglected." And Bakr said: Muhammad ibn Bakr al-Bursani related to us: Uthman ibn Abi Rawwad informed us of something similar.

records.arabic: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم قال حدثنا هشام عن قتادة عن أنس قال قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إن أحدكم إذا صلى يناجي ربه فلا يتفلن عن يمينه ولكن تحت قدمه اليسرى وقال سعيد عن قتادة لا يتفل قدامه أو بين يديه ولكن عن يساره أو تحت قدميه وقال شعبة لا يبزق بين يديه ولا عن يمينه ولكن عن يساره أو تحت قدمه وقال حميد عن أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لا يبزق في القبلة ولا عن يمينه ولكن عن يساره أو تحت قدمه
records.english: Muslim ibn Ibrahim related to us, saying: Hisham related to us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "When one of you prays, he speaks privately with his Lord. He must not spit to his right, but beneath his left foot." And Said said, from Qatadah, "He must not spit ahead of him, or in front of him, but to his left or beneath his feet." And Shubah said, "He must not spit in front of him or to his right, but to his left or beneath his foot." And Humayd said, from Anas, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, "He must not spit toward the prayer direction or to his right, but to his left or beneath his foot."

segments.arabic: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم قال حدثنا هشام عن قتادة عن أنس قال قال النبي
صلى الله عليه وسلم إن أحدكم إذا صلى يناجي ربه فلا يتفلن عن يمينه ولكن تحت قدمه اليسرى
وقال سعيد عن قتادة
لا يتفل قدامه أو بين يديه ولكن عن يساره أو تحت قدميه
وقال شعبة
لا يبزق بين يديه ولا عن يمينه ولكن عن يساره أو تحت قدمه
وقال حميد عن أنس عن النبي
صلى الله عليه وسلم لا يبزق في القبلة ولا عن يمينه ولكن عن يساره أو تحت قدمه

records.arabic: حدثنا حفص بن عمر قال حدثنا يزيد بن إبراهيم قال حدثنا قتادة عن أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال اعتدلوا في السجود ولا يبسط ذراعيه كالكلب وإذا بزق فلا يبزقن بين يديه ولا عن يمينه فإنه يناجي ربه
records.english: Hafs ibn Umar related to us, saying: Yazid ibn Ibrahim related to us, saying: Qatadah related to us, from Anas, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, who said, "Keep a balanced posture in prostration; he must not spread his forearms like a dog. When he spits, he must not spit in front of him or to his right, for he is speaking privately with his Lord."

records.arabic: حدثنا أيوب بن سليمان قال حدثنا أبو بكر عن سليمان قال صالح بن كيسان حدثنا الأعرج عبد الرحمن وغيره عن أبي هريرة ونافع مولى عبد الله بن عمر عن عبد الله بن عمر أنهما حدثاه عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال إذا اشتد الحر فأبردوا عن الصلاة فإن شدة الحر من فيح جهنم
records.english: Ayyub ibn Sulayman related to us, saying: Abu Bakr related to us, from Sulayman. The wording continues: Salih ibn Kaysan said: al-Araj, Abdurrahman, and others related to us, from Abu Hurayrah, and Nafi, the freedman of Abdullah ibn Umar, from Abdullah ibn Umar: the two of them related to him from the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم that he said, "When the heat grows intense, wait for it to cool before prayer, for intense heat is from the blazing breath of Hell."

records.arabic: حدثنا بن بشار قال حدثنا غندر قال حدثنا شعبة عن المهاجر أبي الحسن سمع زيد بن وهب عن أبي ذر قال أذن مؤذن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الظهر فقال أبرد أبرد أو قال انتظر انتظر وقال شدة الحر من فيح جهنم فإذا اشتد الحر فأبردوا عن الصلاة حتى رأينا فيء التلول
records.english: Ibn Bashshar related to us, saying: Ghundar related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, from al-Muhajir Abu al-Hasan, who heard Zayd ibn Wahb, from Abu Dharr, who said: The caller to prayer of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم called for the noon prayer. He said, "Wait for it to cool, wait for it to cool," or he said, "Wait, wait." And he said, "Intense heat is from the blazing breath of Hell. When the heat grows intense, wait for it to cool before prayer"—until we saw the shadows of the mounds.

records.arabic: حدثنا علي بن عبد الله قال حدثنا سفيان قال حفظناه من الزهري عن سعيد بن المسيب عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال إذا اشتد الحر فأبردوا بالصلاة فإن شدة الحر من فيح جهنم واشتكت النار إلى ربها فقالت يا رب أكل بعضي بعضا فأذن لها بنفسين نفس في الشتاء ونفس في الصيف فهو أشد ما تجدون من الحر وأشد ما تجدون من الزمهرير
records.english: Ali ibn Abdullah related to us, saying: Sufyan related to us, saying: We memorized it from al-Zuhri, from Said ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, who said, "When the heat grows intense, wait for it to cool before prayer, for intense heat is from the blazing breath of Hell. And Hell complained to her Lord, saying, 'O Lord, parts of me have eaten other parts.' So He permitted her two breaths, a breath in winter and a breath in summer. That is the most intense heat you experience and the most intense bitter cold you experience."

records.english: Umar ibn Hafs related to us, saying: My father related to us, saying: al-Amash related to us: Abu Salih related to us, from Abu Said, who said: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Wait for it to cool for the noon prayer, for intense heat is from the blazing breath of Hell." Sufyan and Yahya and Abu Awanah followed him in reporting it from al-Amash.

records.arabic: حدثنا آدم بن أبي إياس قال حدثنا شعبة قال حدثنا مهاجر أبو الحسن مولى لبني تيم الله قال سمعت زيد بن وهب عن أبي ذر الغفاري قال كنا مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في سفر فأراد المؤذن أن يؤذن للظهر فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أبرد ثم أراد أن يؤذن فقال له أبرد حتى رأينا فيء التلول فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إن شدة الحر من فيح جهنم فإذا اشتد الحر فأبردوا بالصلاة وقال بن عباس يتفيأ يتميل
records.english: Adam ibn Abi Iyas related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, saying: Muhajir Abu al-Hasan, a freedman of Banu Taym Allah, related to us, saying: I heard Zayd ibn Wahb, from Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, who said: We were with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم on a journey. The caller to prayer wanted to call for the noon prayer. And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Wait for it to cool." Then he wanted to make the call, and he said to him, "Wait for it to cool," until we saw the shadows of the mounds. And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Intense heat is from the blazing breath of Hell. When the heat grows intense, wait for it to cool before prayer." And Ibn Abbas said, "'It casts its shadow' means 'it inclines.'"

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو اليمان قال أخبرنا شعيب عن الزهري قال أخبرني أنس بن مالك أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم خرج حين زاغت الشمس فصلى الظهر فقام على المنبر فذكر الساعة فذكر أن فيها أمورا عظاما ثم قال من أحب أن يسأل عن شيء فليسأل فلا تسألوني عن شيء إلا أخبرتكم ما دمت في مقامي هذا فأكثر الناس في البكاء وأكثر أن يقول سلوني فقام عبد الله بن حذافة السهمي فقال من أبي قال أبوك حذافة ثم أكثر أن يقول سلوني فبرك عمر على ركبتيه فقال رضينا بالله ربا وبالإسلام دينا وبمحمد نبيا فسكت ثم قال عرضت علي الجنة والنار آنفا في عرض هذا الحائط فلم أر كالخير والشر \ 1 \
records.english: Abu al-Yaman related to us, saying: Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Anas ibn Malik informed me that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم went out when the sun declined and prayed the noon prayer. He stood on the pulpit and mentioned the Hour, mentioning that it would contain tremendous events. Then he said, "Whoever would like to ask about something, let him ask. You will not ask me about anything without my telling you, as long as I remain standing here." The people wept profusely, and he repeatedly said, "Ask me." Abdullah ibn Hudhafah al-Sahmi stood and said, "Who is my father?" He said, "Your father is Hudhafah." Then he repeatedly said, "Ask me." Umar knelt on his knees and said, "We have found contentment in God as Lord and Islam as religion and Muhammad as prophet." He fell silent. Then he said, "Paradise and Hell were just shown to me across the breadth of this wall. I have never seen the like of the good and the evil." \ 1 \

records.arabic: حدثنا حفص بن عمر قال حدثنا شعبة عن أبي المنهال عن أبي برزة كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي الصبح وأحدنا يعرف جليسه ويقرأ فيها ما بين الستين إلى المائة ويصلي الظهر إذا زالت الشمس والعصر وأحدنا يذهب إلى أقصى المدينة ثم يرجع والشمس حية ونسيت ما قال في المغرب ولا نبالي بتأخير العشاء إلى ثلث الليل ثم قال إلى شطر الليل وقال معاذ قال شعبة ثم لقيته مرة فقال أو ثلث الليل
records.english: Hafs ibn Umar related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, from Abu al-Minhal, from Abu Barzah: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to pray the morning prayer when one of us could recognize his companion sitting beside him, and he would recite between sixty and a hundred in it. He prayed the noon prayer when the sun declined, and the afternoon prayer when one of us could go to the furthest part of Medina and return while the sun was still bright. I forgot what he said about the sunset prayer. We did not mind delaying the night prayer to a third of the night; then he said, to half the night. And Muadh said: Shubah said: Then I met him once, and he said, "Or a third of the night."

records.english: Muhammad, meaning Ibn Muqatil, related to us, saying: Abdullah informed us, saying: Khalid ibn Abdurrahman informed us: Ghalib al-Qattan related to me, from Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: When we prayed behind the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم in the midday heat, we prostrated on our clothes to protect ourselves from the heat.

records.english: Abu al-Numan related to us, saying: Hammad, who is Ibn Zayd, related to us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd, from Ibn Abbas: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed seven and eight in Medina: the noon and afternoon prayers, and the sunset and night prayers. Ayyub said, "Perhaps it was on a rainy night." The reply was, "Perhaps."

records.english: Qutaybah related to us, saying: al-Layth related to us, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah, from Aishah: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed the afternoon prayer while the sun was in her chamber; the shadow had not emerged from her chamber. And Abu Usamah said, from Hisham, "From the depth of her chamber."

And Malik and Yahya ibn Said and Shuayb and Ibn Abi Hafsah said, "And the sun, before it rose out."

records.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن مقاتل قال أخبرنا عبد الله قال أخبرنا عوف عن سيار بن سلامة قال دخلت أنا وأبي على أبي برزة الأسلمي فقال له أبي كيف كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي المكتوبة فقال كان يصلي الهجير التي تدعونها الأولى حين تدحض الشمس ويصلي العصر ثم يرجع أحدنا إلى رحله في أقصى المدينة والشمس حية ونسيت ما قال في المغرب وكان يستحب أن يؤخر العشاء التي تدعونها العتمة وكان يكره النوم قبلها والحديث بعدها وكان ينفتل من صلاة الغداة حين يعرف الرجل جليسه ويقرأ بالستين إلى المائة
records.english: Muhammad ibn Muqatil related to us, saying: Abdullah informed us, saying: Awf informed us, from Sayyar ibn Salamah, who said: My father and I went in to Abu Barzah al-Aslami. My father said to him, "How did the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم pray the prescribed prayer?" He said, "He used to pray the midday prayer, which you call the first, when the sun declined, and pray the afternoon prayer, after which one of us could return to his lodging at the furthest part of Medina while the sun was still bright. I forgot what he said about the sunset prayer. He preferred to delay the night prayer, which you call the dark-time prayer. He disliked sleeping before it and conversation after it. He would turn away from the morning prayer when a man could recognize his companion sitting beside him, and he would recite sixty to a hundred."

records.arabic: حدثنا بن مقاتل قال أخبرنا عبد الله قال أخبرنا أبو بكر بن عثمان بن سهل بن حنيف قال سمعت أبا أمامة يقول صلينا مع عمر بن عبد العزيز الظهر ثم خرجنا حتى دخلنا على أنس بن مالك فوجدناه يصلي العصر فقلت يا عم ما هذه الصلاة التي صليت قال العصر وهذه صلاة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم التي كنا نصلي معه
records.english: Ibn Muqatil related to us, saying: Abdullah informed us, saying: Abu Bakr ibn Uthman ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf informed us, saying: I heard Abu Umamah say: We prayed the noon prayer with Umar ibn Abdulaziz. Then we went out until we went in to Anas ibn Malik, and found him praying the afternoon prayer. I said, "Uncle, what is this prayer you have prayed?" He said, "The afternoon prayer. This is the prayer of the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم which we used to pray with him."

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو اليمان قال أخبرنا شعيب عن الزهري قال حدثني أنس بن مالك قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي العصر والشمس مرتفعة حية فيذهب الذاهب إلى العوالي فيأتيهم والشمس مرتفعة وبعض العوالي من المدينة على أربعة أميال أو نحوه

Someone going to al-Awali would reach them while the sun was still high. Some of al-Awali lies four miles from Medina, or thereabouts.

records.arabic: حدثنا الحميدي قال حدثنا مروان بن معاوية قال حدثنا إسماعيل عن قيس عن جرير قال كنا عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فنظر إلى القمر ليلة يعني البدر فقال إنكم سترون ربكم كما ترون هذا القمر لا تضامون في رؤيته فإن استطعتم أن لا تغلبوا على صلاة قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها فافعلوا ثم قرأ وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل الغروب قال إسماعيل افعلوا لا تفوتنكم
records.english: al-Humaydi related to us, saying: Marwan ibn Muawiyah related to us, saying: Ismail related to us, from Qays, from Jarir, who said: We were with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. He looked at the moon one night—meaning the full moon—and said, "You will see your Lord as you see this moon, without being crowded in seeing Him. If you can avoid being overcome so as to miss a prayer before sunrise and before sunset, do so." Then he recited, "Glorify your Lord with praise before sunrise and before sunset." Ismail said, "Do so: do not let them escape you."

records.english: Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us, saying: Malik related to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayrah: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Angels take turns among you by night and angels by day. They meet at the dawn prayer and the afternoon prayer. Then those who spent the night among you ascend, and He asks them—though He knows best about them—'How did you leave My servants?' They say, 'We left them praying, and we came to them praying.'"

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو نعيم قال حدثنا شيبان عن يحيى عن أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أدرك أحدكم سجدة من صلاة العصر قبل أن تغرب الشمس فليتم صلاته وإذا أدرك سجدة من صلاة الصبح قبل أن تطلع الشمس فليتم صلاته
records.english: Abu Nuaym related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "If one of you catches a cycle [literally, a prostration] of the afternoon prayer before the sun sets, let him complete his prayer. And if he catches a cycle [literally, a prostration] of the morning prayer before the sun rises, let him complete his prayer."

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد العزيز بن عبد الله قال حدثني إبراهيم عن بن شهاب عن سالم بن عبد الله عن أبيه أنه أخبره أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول إنما بقاؤكم فيما سلف قبلكم من الأمم كما بين صلاة العصر إلى غروب الشمس أوتي أهل التوراة التوراة فعملوا حتى إذا انتصف النهار عجزوا فأعطوا قيراطا قيراطا ثم أوتي أهل الإنجيل الإنجيل فعملوا إلى صلاة العصر ثم عجزوا فأعطوا قيراطا قيراطا ثم أوتينا القرآن فعملنا إلى غروب الشمس فأعطينا قيراطين قيراطين فقال أهل الكتابين أي ربنا أعطيت هؤلاء قيراطين قيراطين وأعطيتنا قيراطا قيراطا ونحن كنا أكثر عملا قال قال الله عز وجل هل ظلمتكم من أجركم من شيء قالوا لا قال فهو فضلي أوتيه من أشاء
records.english: Abdulaziz ibn Abdullah related to us, saying: Ibrahim related to me, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abdullah, from his father, who informed him that he heard the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم say, "Your remaining duration, compared with the nations that went before you, is only like the interval between the afternoon prayer and sunset. Then the people of the Torah were given the Torah and worked until midday, then became unable to continue, and were given one qirat each. Then the people of the Gospel were given the Gospel and worked until the afternoon prayer, then became unable to continue, and were given one qirat each. Then we were given the Quran and worked until sunset, and were given two qirats each. Then the people of the two Scriptures said, 'O our Lord, You gave these people two qirats each and gave us one qirat each, although we did more work.'" He said: God عز وجل said, "Have I wronged you in any part of your wage?" They said, "No." He said, "It is My favor; I give it to whomever I wish."

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو كريب قال حدثنا أبو أسامة عن بريد عن أبي بردة عن أبي موسى عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مثل المسلمين واليهود والنصارى كمثل رجل استأجر قوما يعملون له عملا إلى الليل فعملوا إلى نصف النهار فقالوا لا حاجة لنا إلى أجرك فاستأجر آخرين فقال أكملوا بقية يومكم ولكم الذي شرطت فعملوا حتى إذا كان حين صلاة العصر قالوا لك ما عملنا فاستأجر قوما فعملوا بقية يومهم حتى غابت الشمس واستكملوا أجر الفريقين
records.english: Abu Kurayb related to us, saying: Abu Usamah related to us, from Burayd, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم: "The likeness of the Muslims and the Jews and the Christians is that of a man who hired people to do work for him until night. They worked until midday, then said, 'We have no need of your wage.' He hired others and said, 'Complete the rest of your day, and you will have what I stipulated.' They worked until the time of the afternoon prayer, then said, 'What we have done is yours.' He hired people who worked for the rest of their day until the sun set, and they received the wages of both groups in full."

records.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن بشار قال حدثنا محمد بن جعفر قال حدثنا شعبة عن سعد عن محمد بن عمرو بن الحسن بن علي قال قدم الحجاج فسألنا جابر بن عبد الله فقال كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي الظهر بالهاجرة والعصر والشمس نقية والمغرب إذا وجبت والعشاء أحيانا وأحيانا إذا رآهم اجتمعوا عجل وإذا رآهم أبطؤوا أخر والصبح كانوا أو كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصليها بغلس \ 1 \
records.english: Muhammad ibn Bashshar related to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Jafar related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, from Sad, from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, who said: al-Hajjaj arrived, and we asked Jabir ibn Abdullah. He said, "the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to pray the noon prayer in the midday heat, and the afternoon prayer while the sun was clear, and the sunset prayer when it set. The night prayer was sometimes one way and sometimes another: when he saw them assembled, he hastened it, and when he saw them slow to come, he delayed it. And the morning prayer, they used to—or the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to—pray it in the early dawn darkness." \ 1 \

He said: The desert Arabs call it the night prayer.

records.arabic: قال أبو هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أثقل الصلاة على المنافقين العشاء والفجر وقال لو يعلمون ما في العتمة والفجر قال أبو عبد الله والاختيار أن يقول العشاء لقوله تعالى ومن بعد صلاة العشاء ويذكر عن أبي موسى قال كنا نتناوب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عند صلاة العشاء فأعتم بها وقال بن عباس وعائشة أعتم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بالعشاء وقال بعضهم عن عائشة أعتم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بالعتمة وقال جابر كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي العشاء وقال أبو برزة كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يؤخر العشاء وقال أنس أخر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم العشاء الآخرة وقال بن عمر وأبو أيوب وبن عباس رضي الله عنهم صلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم المغرب والعشاء )
records.english: Abu Hurayrah said, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, "The prayers most burdensome to the hypocrites are the night prayer and the dawn prayer." And he said, "If they knew what is in the dark-time prayer and the dawn prayer." Abu Abdullah said: The preferred choice is to say "the night prayer," because of His saying تعالى, "And after the night prayer." It is mentioned from Abu Musa, who said: We used to attend the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم in turns at the night prayer, and he delayed it until it was dark. And Ibn Abbas and Aishah said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم delayed the night prayer until it was dark. And some of them said, from Aishah: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم delayed the dark-time prayer until it was dark. And Jabir said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to pray the night prayer. And Abu Barzah said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to delay the night prayer. And Anas said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم delayed the later night prayer. And Ibn Umar and Abu Ayyub and Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهم said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed the sunset and night prayers. )

records.arabic: حدثنا عبدان قال أخبرنا عبد الله قال أخبرنا يونس عن الزهري قال سالم أخبرني عبد الله قال صلى لنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة صلاة العشاء وهي التي يدعو الناس العتمة ثم انصرف فأقبل علينا فقال أرأيتم ليلتكم هذه فإن رأس مائة سنة منها لا يبقى ممن هو على ظهر الأرض أحد
records.english: Abdan related to us, saying: Abdullah informed us, saying: Yunus informed us, from al-Zuhri. The wording continues: Salim said: Abdullah informed me, saying: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم led us one night in the night prayer, which people call the dark-time prayer. Then he turned away and faced us, saying, "Consider this night of yours: at the end of a hundred years from it, none of those who are on the face of the earth will remain."

records.arabic: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم قال حدثنا شعبة عن سعد بن إبراهيم عن محمد بن عمرو هو بن الحسن بن علي قال سألنا جابر بن عبد الله عن صلاة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال كان يصلي الظهر بالهاجرة والعصر والشمس حية والمغرب إذا وجبت والعشاء إذا كثر الناس عجل وإذا قلوا أخر والصبح بغلس
records.english: Muslim ibn Ibrahim related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, from Sad ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Amr, who is Ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, who said: We asked Jabir ibn Abdullah about the prayer of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. He said, "He used to pray the noon prayer in the midday heat, the afternoon prayer while the sun was bright, and the sunset prayer when it set. As for the night prayer, when the people were numerous, he hastened it, and when they were few, he delayed it; and the morning prayer was in the early dawn darkness."

records.arabic: حدثنا يحيى بن بكير قال حدثنا الليث عن عقيل عن بن شهاب عن عروة أن عائشة أخبرته قالت أعتم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة بالعشاء وذلك قبل أن يفشو الإسلام فلم يخرج حتى قال عمر نام النساء والصبيان فخرج فقال لأهل المسجد ما ينتظرها أحد من أهل الأرض غيركم
records.english: Yahya ibn Bukayr related to us, saying: al-Layth related to us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah, that Aishah informed him, saying: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم delayed the night prayer one night until it was dark. That was before Islam had spread. He did not come out until Umar said, "The women and children have fallen asleep." He came out and said to the people in the mosque, "No one on earth is waiting for it except you."

records.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن العلاء قال أخبرنا أبو أسامة عن بريد عن أبي بردة عن أبي موسى قال كنت أنا وأصحابي الذين قدموا معي في السفينة نزولا في بقيع بطحان والنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بالمدينة فكان يتناوب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عند صلاة العشاء كل ليلة نفر منهم فوافقنا النبي عليه السلام أنا وأصحابي وله بعض الشغل في بعض أمره فأعتم بالصلاة حتى ابهار الليل ثم خرج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فصلى بهم فلما قضى صلاته قال لمن حضره على رسلكم أبشروا إن من نعمة الله عليكم أنه ليس أحد من الناس يصلي هذه الساعة غيركم أو قال ما صلى هذه الساعة أحد غيركم لا يدري أي الكلمتين قال قال أبو موسى فرجعنا ففرحنا بما سمعنا من رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.english: Muhammad ibn al-Ala related to us, saying: Abu Usamah informed us, from Burayd, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, who said: My companions who had come with me in the ship and I were staying in Baqi Bathan, and the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم was in Medina. Each night, a group of them would attend the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم in turns at the night prayer. My companions and I happened upon the Prophet عليه السلام while he was occupied with some business of his. He delayed the prayer until the night was fully dark. Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم came out and led them in prayer. When he finished his prayer, he said to those present, "Stay a moment! Receive good news: it is a blessing of God upon you that no one else among the people is praying at this hour except you," or he said, "No one has prayed at this hour except you." It is not known which of the two expressions he said. Abu Musa said: We returned rejoicing at what we had heard from the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم.

records.arabic: حدثنا أيوب بن سليمان قال حدثني أبو بكر عن سليمان قال صالح بن كيسان أخبرني بن شهاب عن عروة أن عائشة قالت أعتم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالعشاء حتى ناداه عمر الصلاة نام النساء والصبيان فخرج فقال ما ينتظرها أحد من أهل الأرض غيركم قال ولا يصلى يومئذ إلا بالمدينة وكانوا يصلون فيما بين أن يغيب الشفق إلى ثلث الليل الأول
records.english: Ayyub ibn Sulayman related to us, saying: Abu Bakr related to me, from Sulayman. The wording continues: Salih ibn Kaysan said: Ibn Shihab informed me, from Urwah, that Aishah said: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم delayed the night prayer until it was dark, until Umar called to him, "The prayer! The women and children have fallen asleep." He came out and said, "No one on earth is waiting for it except you." The account says: At that time prayer was performed only in Medina. They used to pray between the disappearance of the twilight and the first third of the night.

records.arabic: حدثنا محمود قال أخبرنا عبد الرزاق قال أخبرني بن جريج قال أخبرني نافع قال حدثنا عبد الله بن عمر أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم شغل عنها ليلة فأخرها حتى رقدنا في المسجد ثم استيقظنا ثم رقدنا ثم استيقظنا ثم خرج علينا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم قال ليس أحد من أهل الأرض ينتظر الصلاة غيركم وكان بن عمر لا يبالي أقدمها أم أخرها إذا كان لا يخشى أن يغلبه النوم عن وقتها وكان يرقد قبلها قال بن جريج قلت لعطاء فقال سمعت بن عباس يقول أعتم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة بالعشاء حتى رقد الناس واستيقظوا ورقدوا واستيقظوا فقام عمر بن الخطاب فقال الصلاة قال عطاء قال بن عباس فخرج نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كأني أنظر إليه الآن يقطر رأسه ماء واضعا يده على رأسه فقال لولا أن أشق على أمتي لأمرتهم أن يصلوها هكذا فاستثبت عطاء كيف وضع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على رأسه يده كما أنبأه بن عباس فبدد لي عطاء بين أصابعه شيئا من تبديد ثم وضع أطراف أصابعه على قرن الرأس ثم ضمها يمرها كذلك على الرأس حتى مست إبهامه طرف الأذن مما يلي الوجه على الصدغ وناحية اللحية لا يقصر ولا يبطش إلا كذلك وقال لولا أن أشق على أمتي لأمرتهم أن يصلوا هكذا
records.english: Mahmud related to us, saying: Abdurrazzaq informed us, saying: Ibn Jurayj informed me, saying: Nafi informed me, saying: Abdullah ibn Umar related to us: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم was kept occupied from it one night and delayed it until we slept in the mosque, then awoke, then slept, then awoke. Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم came out to us and said, "No one on earth is waiting for the prayer except you." Ibn Umar did not mind whether he performed it early or delayed it, provided he did not fear that sleep would overcome him beyond its time, and he used to sleep before it. Ibn Jurayj said: I spoke to Ata, and he said: I heard Ibn Abbas say: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم delayed the night prayer one night until it was dark, until the people slept and awoke, and slept and awoke. Umar ibn al-Khattab stood and said, "The prayer!" Ata said: Ibn Abbas said: the Prophet of God صلى الله عليه وسلم came out—as though I can see him now—with water dripping from his head, placing his hand on his head. He said, "Were it not that I would cause hardship to my community, I would command them to pray it like this." I asked Ata to establish precisely how the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم placed his hand on his head, as Ibn Abbas had informed him. Ata spread his fingers a little for me, then placed the tips of his fingers on the crown of his head, then drew them together, passing them over his head in that way until his thumb touched the edge of his ear toward the face, at the temple and the side of the beard, neither shortening the movement nor grasping, only like that. And he said, "Were it not that I would cause hardship to my community, I would command them to pray like this."

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الرحيم المحاربي قال حدثنا زائدة عن حميد الطويل عن أنس قال أخر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاة العشاء إلى نصف الليل ثم صلى ثم قال قد صلى الناس وناموا أما إنكم في صلاة ما انتظرتموها وزاد بن أبي مريم أخبرنا يحيى بن أيوب حدثني حميد سمع أنسا كأني أنظر إلى وبيص خاتمه ليلتئذ
records.english: Abdurrahim al-Muharibi related to us, saying: Zaidah related to us, from Humayd al-Tawil, from Anas, who said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم delayed the night prayer until half the night. Then he prayed, then said, "The people have prayed and slept. Indeed, you are in prayer as long as you wait for it." And Ibn Abi Maryam added: Yahya ibn Ayyub informed us: Humayd related to me, having heard Anas: "It is as though I can see the gleam of his ring that night."

records.arabic: حدثنا مسدد قال حدثنا يحيى عن إسماعيل حدثنا قيس قال لي جرير بن عبد الله كنا عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذ نظر إلى القمر ليلة البدر فقال أما إنكم سترون ربكم كما ترون هذا لا تضامون أو لا تضاهون في رؤيته فإن استطعتم أن لا تغلبوا على صلاة قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها فافعلوا ثم قال وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها
records.english: Musaddad related to us, saying: Yahya related to us, from Ismail: Qays related to us, saying: Jarir ibn Abdullah said to me: We were with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم when he looked at the moon on the night of the full moon and said, "Indeed, you will see your Lord as you see this, without crowding one another—or without vying with one another—in seeing Him. If you can avoid being overcome so as to miss a prayer before sunrise and before sunset, do so." Then he said, "Glorify your Lord with praise before sunrise and before sunset."

records.english: Hasan ibn Sabbah related to us; he heard Rawh: Said related to us, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم and Zayd ibn Thabit ate the predawn meal. When they had finished their predawn meal, the Prophet of God صلى الله عليه وسلم rose for prayer and prayed. We said to Anas, "How much time was between their finishing their predawn meal and their entering the prayer?" He said, "The measure of a man's reciting fifty verses."

records.english: Yahya ibn Bukayr related to us, saying: al-Layth informed us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me that Aishah informed him, saying: The believing women used to attend the dawn prayer with the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم, wrapped in their cloaks. Then they would return to their houses when they had finished the prayer, with no one recognizing them because of the darkness.

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة عن مالك عن زيد بن أسلم عن عطاء بن يسار وعن بسر بن سعيد وعن الأعرج يحدثونه عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال من أدرك من الصبح ركعة قبل أن تطلع الشمس فقد أدرك الصبح ومن أدرك ركعة من العصر قبل أن تغرب الشمس فقد أدرك العصر

records.english: Musaddad related to us, saying: Yahya ibn Said related to us, from Hisham, who said: My father informed me, saying: Ibn Umar informed me, saying: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Do not aim your prayer at the rising of the sun or its setting." And he said: Ibn Umar related to me, saying: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "When the rim of the sun appears, delay prayer until it rises high, and when the rim of the sun disappears, delay prayer until it disappears entirely." Abdah followed him in reporting it.

records.english: Ubayd ibn Ismail related to us, from Abu Usamah, from Ubaydullah, from Khubayb ibn Abdurrahman, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Hurayrah: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم forbade two sales, two ways of dressing, and two prayers. He forbade prayer after the dawn prayer until the sun rises, and after the afternoon prayer until the sun sets; wrapping oneself in a garment with no opening for the arms; sitting with the knees drawn up inside a single garment, exposing one's private parts to the sky; and sales by throwing an object and by touching it.

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو نعيم قال حدثنا عبد الواحد بن أيمن قال حدثني أبي أنه سمع عائشة قالت والذي ذهب به ما تركهما حتى لقي الله وما لقي الله تعالى حتى ثقل عن الصلاة وكان يصلي كثيرا من صلاته قاعدا تعني الركعتين بعد العصر وكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصليهما ولا يصليهما في المسجد مخافة أن يثقل على أمته وكان يحب ما يخفف عنهم
records.english: Abu Nuaym related to us, saying: Abdulwahid ibn Ayman related to us, saying: My father related to me that he heard Aishah say, "I swear by the One who took him away: he did not abandon the two until he met God, and he did not meet God تعالى until prayer had become burdensome for him. He used to perform much of his prayer sitting"—she meant the two cycles after the afternoon prayer. And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to pray them, but would not pray them in the mosque, for fear of making things burdensome for his community. He loved what made things easier for them.

records.arabic: حدثنا عمران بن ميسرة قال حدثنا محمد بن فضيل قال حدثنا حصين عن عبد الله بن أبي قتادة عن أبيه قال سرنا مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة فقال بعض القوم لو عرست بنا يا رسول الله قال أخاف أن تناموا عن الصلاة قال بلال أنا أوقظكم فاضطجعوا وأسند بلال ظهره إلى راحلته فغلبته عيناه فنام فاستيقظ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وقد طلع حاجب الشمس فقال يا بلال أين ما قلت قال ما ألقيت علي نومة مثلها قط قال إن الله قبض أرواحكم حين شاء وردها عليكم حين شاء يا بلال قم فأذن بالناس بالصلاة فتوضأ فلما ارتفعت الشمس وابياضت قام فصلى
records.english: Imran ibn Maysarah related to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Fudayl related to us, saying: Husayn related to us, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father, who said: We traveled with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم one night. Some of the people said, "If only you would stop for us to rest, O Messenger of God." He said, "I fear that you will sleep through the prayer." Bilal said, "I will wake you." They lay down, and Bilal leaned his back against his mount, but his eyes overcame him and he slept. And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم awoke when the rim of the sun had appeared. He said, "O Bilal, where is what you said?" He said, "Never has a sleep like this been cast upon me." He said, "God took your souls when He wished and returned them to you when He wished. O Bilal, stand and call the people to prayer." He performed ablution, and when the sun rose high and grew white, he stood and prayed.

records.arabic: حدثنا معاذ بن فضالة قال حدثنا هشام عن يحيى عن أبي سلمة عن جابر بن عبد الله أن عمر بن الخطاب جاء يوم الخندق بعد ما غربت الشمس فجعل يسب كفار قريش قال يا رسول الله ما كدت أصلي العصر حتى كادت الشمس تغرب قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم والله ما صليتها فقمنا إلى بطحان فتوضأ للصلاة وتوضأنا لها فصلى العصر بعد ما غربت الشمس ثم صلى بعدها المغرب
records.english: Muadh ibn Fadalah related to us, saying: Hisham related to us, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: Umar ibn al-Khattab came on the day of the Trench after the sun had set and began reviling the unbelievers of Quraysh. He said, "O Messenger of God, I scarcely managed to pray the afternoon prayer before the sun nearly set." And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "I swear by God, I have not prayed it." We rose and went to Bathan. He performed ablution for the prayer, and we performed ablution for it. He prayed the afternoon prayer after the sun had set, then prayed the sunset prayer after it.

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو نعيم وموسى بن إسماعيل قالا حدثنا همام عن قتادة عن أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال من نسي صلاة فليصل إذا ذكرها لا كفارة لها إلا ذلك وأقم الصلاة للذكرى قال موسى قال همام سمعته يقول بعد وأقم الصلاة لذكري وقال حبان حدثنا همام حدثنا قتادة حدثنا أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نحوه
records.english: Abu Nuaym and Musa ibn Ismail related to us, saying: Hammam related to us, from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, who said, "Whoever forgets a prayer should pray when he remembers it. There is no expiation for it other than that. 'And establish prayer for remembrance.'" Musa said: Hammam said: I heard him say afterward, "And establish prayer for My remembrance." And Hibban said: Hammam related to us: Qatadah related to us: Anas related to us, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, something similar.

records.arabic: حدثنا مسدد قال حدثنا يحيى قال حدثنا عوف قال حدثنا أبو المنهال قال انطلقت مع أبي إلى أبي برزة الأسلمي فقال له أبي حدثنا كيف كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي المكتوبة قال كان يصلي الهجير وهي التي تدعونها الأولى حين تدحض الشمس ويصلي العصر ثم يرجع أحدنا إلى أهله في أقصى المدينة والشمس حية ونسيت ما قال في المغرب قال وكان يستحب أن يؤخر العشاء قال وكان يكره النوم قبلها والحديث بعدها وكان ينفتل من صلاة الغداة حين يعرف أحدنا جليسه ويقرأ من الستين إلى المائة
records.english: Musaddad related to us, saying: Yahya related to us, saying: Awf related to us, saying: Abu al-Minhal related to us, saying: I went with my father to Abu Barzah al-Aslami. My father said to him, "Tell us how the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم used to pray the prescribed prayer." He said, "He used to pray the midday prayer, which is what you call the first, when the sun declined, and pray the afternoon prayer, after which one of us could return to his family at the furthest part of Medina while the sun was still bright. I forgot what he said about the sunset prayer." The account continues: He preferred to delay the night prayer. The account continues: He disliked sleeping before it and conversation after it. He would turn away from the morning prayer when one of us could recognize his companion sitting beside him, and he would recite sixty to a hundred.

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن الصباح قال حدثنا أبو علي الحنفي حدثنا قرة بن خالد قال انتظرنا الحسن وراث علينا حتى قربنا من وقت قيامه فجاء فقال دعانا جيراننا هؤلاء ثم قال قال أنس نظرنا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ذات ليلة حتى كان شطر الليل يبلغه فجاء فصلى لنا ثم خطبنا فقال ألا إن الناس قد صلوا ثم رقدوا وإنكم لم تزالوا في صلاة ما انتظرتم الصلاة قال الحسن وإن القوم لا يزالون بخير ما انتظروا الخير قال قرة هو من حديث أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.english: Abdullah ibn al-Sabbah related to us, saying: Abu Ali al-Hanafi related to us: Qurrah ibn Khalid related to us, saying: We waited for al-Hasan, and he was slow in coming to us, until we drew near the time when he would rise. He came and said, "These neighbors of ours invited us." Then he said: Anas said: We waited for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم one night until it was half the night, reaching it. He came and led us in prayer, then addressed us, saying, "Indeed, the people have prayed and then slept, while you have remained in prayer as long as you have waited for prayer." al-Hasan said, "The people continue in good as long as they wait for good." Qurrah said, "It is part of Anas's report from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم."

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو اليمان قال أخبرنا شعيب عن الزهري قال حدثني سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر وأبو بكر بن أبي حثمة أن عبد الله بن عمر قال صلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاة العشاء في آخر حياته فلما سلم قام النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال أرأيتكم ليلتكم هذه فإن رأس مائة لا يبقى ممن هو اليوم على ظهر الأرض أحد فوهل الناس في مقالة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى ما يتحدثون من هذه الأحاديث عن مائة سنة وإنما قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لا يبقى ممن هو اليوم على ظهر الأرض يريد بذلك أنها تخرم ذلك القرن
records.english: Abu al-Yaman related to us, saying: Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Salim ibn Abdullah ibn Umar and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Hathmah related to me that Abdullah ibn Umar said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم prayed the night prayer near the end of his life. When he had given the concluding greeting, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم stood and said, "Consider this night of yours: at the end of a hundred, none of those who are on the face of the earth today will remain." People misunderstood the saying of the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم in the direction of these accounts they relate about a hundred years. In fact, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم had only said, "None of those who are on the face of the earth today will remain," meaning that it would bring that generation to its end.

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو النعمان قال حدثنا معتمر بن سليمان قال حدثنا أبي حدثنا أبو عثمان عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي بكر أن أصحاب الصفة كانوا أناسا فقراء وأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال من كان عنده طعام اثنين فليذهب بثالث وإن أربع فخامس أو سادس وأن أبا بكر جاء بثلاثة فانطلق النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بعشرة قال فهو أنا وأبي وأمي فلا أدري قال وامرأتي وخادم بيننا وبين بيت أبي بكر وإن أبا بكر تعشى عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم لبث حيث صليت العشاء ثم رجع فلبث حتى تعشى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فجاء بعد ما مضى من الليل ما شاء الله قالت له امرأته وما حبسك عن أضيافك أو قالت ضيفك قال أو ما عشيتيهم قالت أبوا حتى تجيء قد عرضوا فأبوا قال فذهبت أنا فاختبأت فقال يا غنثر فجدع وسب وقال كلوا لا هنيا فقال والله لا أطعمه أبدا وأيم الله ما كنا نأخذ من لقمة إلا ربا من أسفلها أكثر منها قال يعني حتى شبعوا وصارت أكثر مما كانت قبل ذلك فنظر إليها أبو بكر فإذا هي كما هي أو أكثر منها فقال لامرأته يا أخت بني فراس ما هذا قالت لا وقرة عيني لهي الآن أكثر منها قبل ذلك بثلاث مرات فأكل منها أبو بكر وقال إنما كان ذلك من الشيطان يعني يمينه ثم أكل منها لقمة ثم حملها إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأصبحت عنده وكان بيننا وبين قوم عقد فمضى الأجل ففرقنا اثنى عشر رجلا مع كل رجل منهم أناس الله أعلم كم مع كل رجل فأكلوا منها أجمعون أو كما قال بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
records.english: Abu al-Numan related to us, saying: Mutamir ibn Sulayman related to us, saying: My father related to us: Abu Uthman related to us, from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Bakr: the people of the Suffah were poor people. And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Whoever has food for two should take a third, and if for four, then a fifth or a sixth." Abu Bakr brought three, and the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم went off with ten. The account says: It was I, my father, and my mother—I do not know whether he said, "And my wife"—and a servant between us and the house of Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr ate supper with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, then stayed where the night prayer was performed. Then he returned and remained until the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم had eaten supper. He came after as much of the night had passed as God wished. His wife said to him, "What kept you from your guests?" or she said, "Your guest?" He said, "Did you not give them supper?" She said, "They refused until you came. It was offered to them, but they refused." The account says: I went and hid. He said, "You fool!" and cursed and reviled, and said, "Eat, with no enjoyment!" He said, "I swear by God, I will never taste it." The account continues: and by God, whenever we took a morsel, more than it grew up from beneath it—meaning until they were full, and it had become more than it had been before. Abu Bakr looked at it, and there it was, as it had been or more. He said to his wife, "Sister of Banu Firas, what is this?" She said, "No, by the delight of my eye, it is now three times more than it was before." Abu Bakr ate some of it and said, "That was only from Satan," meaning his oath. Then he ate a morsel of it, then carried it to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, and it was with him in the morning. There was a covenant between us and some people, and the term elapsed. We distributed twelve men, with people accompanying each of them—God knows best how many were with each man—and they all ate from it, or as he said. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

records.arabic: حدثنا محمود بن غيلان قال حدثنا عبد الرزاق قال أخبرنا بن جريج قال أخبرني نافع أن بن عمر كان يقول كان المسلمون حين قدموا المدينة يجتمعون فيتحينون الصلاة ليس ينادى لها فتكلموا يوما في ذلك فقال بعضهم اتخذوا ناقوسا مثل ناقوس النصارى وقال بعضهم بل بوقا مثل قرن اليهود فقال عمر أولا تبعثون رجلا ينادي بالصلاة فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يا بلال قم فناد بالصلاة
records.english: Mahmud ibn Ghaylan related to us, saying: Abdurrazzaq related to us, saying: Ibn Jurayj informed us, saying: Nafi informed me that Ibn Umar used to say: When the Muslims arrived in Medina, they would gather and look out for the time of prayer; no call was made for it. One day they discussed this. Some said, "Use a bell like the bell of the Christians." Others said, "Rather, a trumpet like the horn of the Jews." Umar said, "Will you not send a man to call to prayer?" Then the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "O Bilal, get up and call to prayer."

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال أخبرنا مالك عن أبي الزناد عن الأعرج عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال إذا نودي للصلاة أدبر الشيطان وله ضراط حتى لا يسمع التأذين فإذا قضي النداء أقبل حتى إذا ثوب بالصلاة أدبر حتى إذا قضي التثويب أقبل حتى يخطر بين المرء ونفسه يقول اذكر كذا اذكر كذا لما لم يكن يذكر حتى يظل الرجل لا يدري كم صلى
records.english: Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us, saying: Malik informed us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "When the call to prayer is made, Satan turns and flees, farting so that he will not hear the call. When the call is finished, he returns. Then, when the announcement for commencing prayer is made, he turns and flees. When that announcement is finished, he returns, until he comes between a person and his own mind, saying, 'Remember this; remember that,' about things he had not been remembering, until the man no longer knows how much he has prayed."

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال أخبرنا مالك عن عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن أبي صعصعة الأنصاري ثم المازني عن أبيه أنه أخبره أن أبا سعيد الخدري قال له إني أراك تحب الغنم والبادية فإذا كنت في غنمك أو باديتك فأذنت بالصلاة فارفع صوتك بالنداء فإنه لا يسمع مدى صوت المؤذن جن ولا إنس ولا شيء إلا شهد له يوم القيامة قال أبو سعيد سمعته من رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.english: Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us, saying: Malik informed us, from Abdurrahman ibn Abdullah ibn Abdurrahman ibn Abi Sasaa al-Ansari, then al-Mazini, from his father, who informed him that Abu Said al-Khudri said to him: "I see that you love sheep and the open country. When you are among your sheep or in your open country and give the call to prayer, raise your voice in the call. No jinn, human being, or anything else hears the reach of the caller's voice without bearing witness for him on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Said said: "I heard it from the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم."

records.arabic: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد قال حدثنا إسماعيل بن جعفر عن حميد عن أنس بن مالك أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا غزا بنا قوما لم يكن يغزو بنا حتى يصبح وينظر فإن سمع أذانا كف عنهم وإن لم يسمع أذانا أغار عليهم قال فخرجنا إلى خيبر فانتهينا إليهم ليلا فلما أصبح ولم يسمع أذانا ركب وركبت خلف أبي طلحة وإن قدمي لتمس قدم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال فخرجوا إلينا بمكاتلهم ومساحيهم فلما رأوا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قالوا محمد والله محمد والخميس قال فلما رآهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال الله أكبر الله أكبر خربت خيبر إنا إذا نزلنا بساحة قوم فساء صباح المنذرين
records.english: Qutaybah ibn Said related to us, saying: Ismail ibn Jafar related to us, from Humayd, from Anas ibn Malik, that when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم went on a campaign against a people with us, he would not attack them with us until morning came and he observed. If he heard a call to prayer, he refrained from attacking them; if he heard no call to prayer, he raided them. He said: We went out to Khaybar and reached them at night. When morning came and he heard no call to prayer, he mounted, and I mounted behind Abu Talhah; my foot was indeed touching the foot of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. He said: They came out toward us with their baskets and spades. When they saw the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, they said, "Muhammad! by God, Muhammad and the army!" He said: When the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم saw them, he said, "God is greater! God is greater! Khaybar is ruined! When we descend upon a people's courtyard, evil is the morning of those who have been warned."

records.arabic: حدثنا مسدد قال حدثنا حماد عن أيوب وعبد الحميد صاحب الزيادي وعاصم الأحول عن عبد الله بن الحارث قال خطبنا بن عباس في يوم ردغ فلما بلغ المؤذن حي على الصلاة فأمره أن ينادي الصلاة في الرحال فنظر القوم بعضهم إلى بعض فقال فعل هذا من هو خير منه وإنها عزمة
records.english: Musaddad related to us, saying: Hammad related to us, from Ayyub and Abdulhamid, the companion of al-Ziyadi, and Asim al-Ahwal, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith, who said: Ibn Abbas addressed us on a muddy day. When the caller reached "Come to prayer," he ordered him to call, "Prayer in the dwellings." The people looked at one another. He said: "Someone better than he did this, and it is indeed a binding obligation."

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة عن مالك عن بن شهاب عن سالم بن عبد الله عن أبيه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال إن بلالا يؤذن بليل فكلوا واشربوا حتى ينادي بن أم مكتوم ثم قال وكان رجلا أعمى لا ينادي حتى يقال له أصبحت أصبحت
records.english: Abdullah ibn Maslamah related to us, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abdullah, from his father, that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "Bilal gives the call to prayer at night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls." Then he said: He was a blind man and would not call until he was told, "Morning has come upon you! Morning has come upon you!"

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال أخبرنا مالك عن نافع عن عبد الله بن عمر قال أخبرتني حفصة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا اعتكف المؤذن للصبح وبدا الصبح صلى ركعتين خفيفتين قبل أن تقام الصلاة

records.arabic: ( 13 باب الأذان قبل الفجر )
records.english: 13. Chapter: The call to prayer before dawn

segments.arabic: ( 13 باب الأذان قبل الفجر )

isnad.note: Fresh Arabic-only physical source-role extraction; text is unchanged and no historical authentication is claimed.

records.arabic: حدثنا أحمد بن يونس قال حدثنا زهير قال حدثنا سليمان التيمي عن أبي عثمان النهدي عن عبد الله بن مسعود عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لا يمنعن أحدكم أو أحدا منكم أذان بلال من سحوره فإنه يؤذن أو ينادي بليل ليرجع قائمكم ولينبه نائمكم وليس أن يقول الفجر أو الصبح وقال بأصابعه ورفعها إلى فوق وطأطأ إلى أسفل حتى يقول هكذا وقال زهير بسبابتيه إحداهما فوق الأخرى ثم مدها عن يمينه وشماله
records.english: Ahmad ibn Yunus related to us, saying: Zuhayr related to us, saying: Sulayman al-Taymi related to us, from Abu Uthman al-Nahdi, from Abdullah ibn Masud, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, who said: "Do not let Bilal's call to prayer prevent any one of you—or anyone among you—from his predawn meal, for he gives the call to prayer—or calls—at night, to bring back the one among you who is standing in prayer and awaken the one among you who is asleep. Dawn—or morning—is not that it should be like this"—and he gestured with his fingers, raising them upward and lowering them downward—"until it is like this." Zuhayr gestured with his two index fingers, one above the other, and then extended them to his right and left.

segments.arabic: حدثنا أحمد بن يونس قال حدثنا زهير قال حدثنا سليمان التيمي عن أبي عثمان النهدي عن عبد الله بن مسعود عن النبي

صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لا يمنعن أحدكم أو أحدا منكم أذان بلال من سحوره فإنه يؤذن أو ينادي بليل ليرجع قائمكم ولينبه نائمكم وليس أن يقول الفجر أو الصبح وقال بأصابعه ورفعها إلى فوق وطأطأ إلى أسفل حتى يقول هكذا
وقال زهير بسبابتيه إحداهما فوق الأخرى ثم مدها عن يمينه وشماله

records.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن بشار قال حدثنا غندر قال حدثنا شعبة قال سمعت عمرو بن عامر الأنصاري عن أنس بن مالك قال كان المؤذن إذا أذن قام ناس من أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يبتدرون السواري حتى يخرج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وهم كذلك يصلون الركعتين قبل المغرب ولم يكن بين الأذان والإقامة شيء قال عثمان بن جبلة وأبو داود عن شعبة لم يكن بينهما إلا قليل
records.english: Muhammad ibn Bashshar related to us, saying: Ghundar related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, saying: I heard Amr ibn Amir al-Ansari, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: When the caller gave the call to prayer, some of the companions of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم would get up and hurry to the pillars, until the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم came out while they were still like that, praying the two units before the sunset prayer. There was nothing between the call to prayer and the announcement for commencing it. Uthman ibn Jabalah and Abu Dawud reported from Shubah: "There was only a little between them."

segments.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن بشار قال حدثنا غندر قال حدثنا شعبة قال سمعت عمرو بن عامر الأنصاري عن أنس بن مالك
قال كان المؤذن إذا أذن قام ناس من أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يبتدرون السواري حتى يخرج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وهم كذلك يصلون الركعتين قبل المغرب ولم يكن بين الأذان والإقامة شيء
قال عثمان بن جبلة وأبو داود عن شعبة
لم يكن بينهما إلا قليل

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو اليمان قال أخبرنا شعيب عن الزهري قال أخبرني عروة بن الزبير أن عائشة قالت كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا سكت المؤذن بالأولى من صلاة الفجر قام فركع ركعتين خفيفتين قبل صلاة الفجر بعد أن يستبين الفجر ثم اضطجع على شقه الأيمن حتى يأتيه المؤذن للإقامة
records.english: Abu al-Yaman related to us, saying: Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me that Aishah said: When the caller fell silent after the first call for the dawn prayer, the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم would get up and pray two brief units before the dawn prayer, after dawn had become clear. He would then lie down on his right side until the caller came to him for the announcement for commencing prayer.

records.arabic: حدثنا معلى بن أسد قال حدثنا وهيب عن أيوب عن أبي قلابة عن مالك بن الحويرث أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في نفر من قومي فأقمنا عنده عشرين ليلة وكان رحيما رفيقا فلما رأى شوقنا إلى أهالينا قال ارجعوا فكونوا فيهم وعلموهم وصلوا فإذا حضرت الصلاة فليؤذن لكم أحدكم وليؤمكم أكبركم
records.english: Mualla ibn Asad related to us, saying: Wuhayb related to us, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Malik ibn al-Huwayrith: I came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم with a group of my people. We stayed with him twenty nights. He was merciful and gentle. When he saw our longing for our families, he said: "Go back and be among them, teach them, and pray. When the time of prayer comes, let one of you give the call to prayer for you, and let the oldest of you lead you."

records.english: Muslim ibn Ibrahim related to us, saying: Shubah related to us, from al-Muhajir Abu al-Hasan, from Zayd ibn Wahb, from Abu Dharr, who said: We were with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم on a journey. The caller wanted to give the call to prayer, but he said to him, "Wait for it to cool." Then he wanted to give the call, but he said to him, "Wait for it to cool." Then he wanted to give the call, but he said to him, "Wait for it to cool," until the shadow equaled the hillocks. Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "The intensity of the heat is from the blazing of Hell."

records.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى قال حدثنا عبد الوهاب قال حدثنا أيوب عن أبي قلابة قال حدثنا مالك أتينا إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ونحن شببة متقاربون فأقمنا عنده عشرين يوما وليلة وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رحيما رفيقا فلما ظن أنا قد اشتهينا أهلنا أو قد اشتقنا سألنا عمن تركنا بعدنا فأخبرناه قال ارجعوا إلى أهليكم فأقيموا فيهم وعلموهم ومروهم وذكر أشياء أحفظها أو لا أحفظها وصلوا كما رأيتموني أصلي فإذا حضرت الصلاة فليؤذن لكم أحدكم وليؤمكم أكبركم
records.english: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna related to us, saying: Abdulwahhab related to us, saying: Ayyub related to us, from Abu Qilabah, who said: Malik related to us: We came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم as young men of similar age and stayed with him twenty days and nights. And the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم was merciful and gentle. When he thought that we desired our families, or had become homesick, he asked us whom we had left behind, and we told him. He said: "Go back to your families, stay among them, teach them, and instruct them." He mentioned things which I remember—or do not remember. "And pray as you have seen me pray. When the time of prayer comes, let one of you give the call to prayer for you, and let the oldest of you lead you."

records.arabic: ( 19 باب هل يتبع المؤذن فاه ها هنا وههنا وهل يلتفت في الأذان
records.english: 19. Chapter: Does the caller move his mouth this way and that, and does he turn during the call to prayer?

segments.arabic: ( 19 باب هل يتبع المؤذن فاه ها هنا وههنا وهل يلتفت في الأذان

records.arabic: ويذكر عن بلال أنه جعل إصبعيه في أذنيه وكان بن عمر لا يجعل إصبعيه في أذنيه وقال إبراهيم لا بأس أن يؤذن على غير وضوء وقال عطاء الوضوء حق وسنة وقالت عائشة كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يذكر الله على كل أحيانه )
records.english: It is mentioned of Bilal that he put his two fingers in his ears. Ibn Umar did not put his two fingers in his ears. Ibrahim said: "There is no harm in giving the call to prayer without ablution." Ata said: "Ablution is a duty and an established practice." Aishah said that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to remember God at all his times.

Pray what you catch, and complete what you miss."

records.english: 24. Chapter: May one leave the mosque for a reason?

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد العزيز بن عبد الله قال حدثنا إبراهيم بن سعد عن صالح بن كيسان عن بن شهاب عن أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم خرج وقد أقيمت الصلاة وعدلت الصفوف حتى إذا قام في مصلاه انتظرنا أن يكبر انصرف قال على مكانكم فمكثنا على هيئتنا حتى خرج إلينا ينطف رأسه ماء وقد اغتسل
records.english: Abdulaziz ibn Abdullah related to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Sad related to us, from Salih ibn Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم came out when the announcement for commencing prayer had been made and the rows had been straightened. When he stood in his place of prayer and we waited for him to say "God is greater," he turned away, saying, "Stay where you are." We remained as we were until he came out to us, his head dripping water, having bathed.

records.arabic: حدثنا إسحاق قال حدثنا محمد بن يوسف قال حدثنا الأوزاعي عن الزهري عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن عن أبي هريرة قال أقيمت الصلاة فسوى الناس صفوفهم فخرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فتقدم وهو جنب ثم قال على مكانكم فرجع فاغتسل ثم خرج ورأسه يقطر ماء فصلى بهم
records.english: Ishaq related to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yusuf related to us, saying: al-Awzai related to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abdurrahman, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The announcement for commencing prayer was made, and the people straightened their rows. Then the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم came out and stepped forward while in a state of major ritual impurity. Then he said, "Stay where you are." He went back and bathed, then came out with water dripping from his head and led them in prayer.

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو نعيم قال حدثنا شيبان عن يحيى قال سمعت أبا سلمة يقول أخبرنا جابر بن عبد الله أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم جاءه عمر بن الخطاب يوم الخندق فقال يا رسول الله والله ما كدت أن أصلي حتى كادت الشمس تغرب وذلك بعد ما أفطر الصائم فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم والله ما صليتها فنزل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى بطحان وأنا معه فتوضأ ثم صلى يعني العصر بعد ما غربت الشمس ثم صلى بعدها المغرب
records.english: Abu Nuaym related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Yahya, who said: I heard Abu Salamah say: Jabir ibn Abdullah informed us that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم was visited by Umar ibn al-Khattab on the day of the Trench. The latter said, "O Messenger of God, by God, I had scarcely managed to pray before the sun had nearly set." That was after the fasting person had broken his fast. Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "by God, I have not prayed it." Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم went down to Bathan, and I was with him. He performed ablution and then prayed—meaning the afternoon prayer—after the sun had set, then prayed the sunset prayer after it.

records.english: Abu Mamar, Abdullah ibn Amr, related to us, saying: Abdulwarith related to us, saying: Abdulaziz ibn Suhayb related to us, from Anas, who said: The announcement for commencing prayer was made, and the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم was speaking privately to a man at one side of the mosque. He did not get up for prayer until the people had fallen asleep.

records.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال أخبرنا مالك عن أبي الزناد عن الأعرج عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال والذي نفسي بيده لقد هممت أن آمر بحطب فيحطب ثم آمر بالصلاة فيؤذن لها ثم آمر رجلا فيؤم الناس ثم أخالف إلى رجال فأحرق عليهم بيوتهم والذي نفسي بيده لو يعلم أحدهم أنه يجد عرقا سمينا أو مرماتين حسنتين لشهد العشاء
records.english: Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us, saying: Malik informed us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, I considered ordering firewood to be gathered, then ordering the prayer and having its call made, then ordering a man to lead the people, and then going to some men and burning their houses over them. By the One in whose hand is my soul, if one of them knew he would find a meaty bone or two fine sheep's feet [the identification of this food term is uncertain], he would attend the night prayer."

segments.arabic: حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال أخبرنا مالك عن أبي الزناد عن الأعرج عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله

records.arabic: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل قال حدثنا عبد الواحد قال حدثنا الأعمش قال سمعت أبا صالح يقول سمعت أبا هريرة يقول قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاة الرجل في الجماعة تضعف على صلاته في بيته وفي سوقه خمسة وعشرين ضعفا وذلك أنه إذا توضأ فأحسن الوضوء ثم خرج إلى المسجد لا يخرجه إلا الصلاة لم يخط خطوة إلا رفعت له بها درجة وحط عنه بها خطيئة فإذا صلى لم تزل الملائكة تصلي عليه ما دام في مصلاه اللهم صل عليه اللهم ارحمه ولا يزال أحدكم في صلاة ما انتظر الصلاة
records.english: Musa ibn Ismail related to us, saying: Abdulwahid related to us, saying: al-Amash related to us, saying: I heard Abu Salih say: I heard Abu Hurayrah say: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "A man's prayer in congregation is multiplied twenty-five times over his prayer in his house or marketplace. That is because, when he performs ablution well and then goes out to the mosque, with nothing bringing him out except prayer, every step he takes raises him a degree and removes a sin from him. When he prays, the angels continue to pray for him while he remains in his place of prayer: 'O God, bless him; O God, have mercy on him.' Each of you remains in prayer as long as he waits for prayer."

segments.arabic: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل قال حدثنا عبد الواحد قال حدثنا الأعمش قال سمعت أبا صالح يقول سمعت أبا هريرة يقول قال رسول الله

records.arabic: حدثنا أبو اليمان قال أخبرنا شعيب عن الزهري قال أخبرني سعيد بن المسيب وأبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن أن أبا هريرة قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول تفضل صلاة الجميع صلاة أحدكم وحده بخمسة وعشرين جزءا وتجتمع ملائكة الليل وملائكة النهار في صلاة الفجر ثم يقول أبو هريرة فاقرؤوا إن شئتم إن قرآن الفجر كان مشهودا قال شعيب وحدثني نافع عن عبد الله بن عمر قال تفضلها بسبع وعشرين درجة
records.english: Abu al-Yaman related to us, saying: Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Said ibn al-Musayyab and Abu Salamah ibn Abdurrahman informed me that Abu Hurayrah said: I heard the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم say: "Congregational prayer surpasses one's prayer alone by twenty-five portions. The angels of the night and the angels of the day meet at the dawn prayer." Then Abu Hurayrah says: "Read, if you wish: 'The recitation at dawn is witnessed.'" Shuayb said: Nafi also related to me, from Abdullah ibn Umar, who said: "It surpasses it by twenty-seven degrees."

segments.arabic: حدثنا أبو اليمان قال أخبرنا شعيب عن الزهري قال أخبرني سعيد بن المسيب وأبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن أن أبا هريرة قال سمعت رسول الله
صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول تفضل صلاة الجميع صلاة أحدكم وحده بخمسة وعشرين جزءا وتجتمع ملائكة الليل وملائكة النهار في صلاة الفجر

records.arabic: حدثنا عمر بن حفص قال حدثنا أبي قال حدثنا الأعمش قال سمعت سالما قال سمعت أم الدرداء تقول دخل علي أبو الدرداء وهو مغضب فقلت ما أغضبك فقال والله ما أعرف من أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم شيئا إلا أنهم يصلون جميعا
records.english: Umar ibn Hafs related to us, saying: My father related to us, saying: al-Amash related to us, saying: I heard Salim say: I heard Umm al-Darda say: Abu al-Darda came in to me angry. I asked, "What has angered you?" He said: "by God, I recognize nothing of the community of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم except that they pray together."

records.english: Muhammad ibn al-Ala related to us, saying: Abu Usamah related to us, from Burayd ibn Abdullah, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, who said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "Those who have the greatest reward for prayer are those whose walk is farthest, then the next farthest. Whoever waits for prayer in order to pray it with the leader has a greater reward than one who prays and then sleeps."

segments.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن العلاء قال حدثنا أبو أسامة عن بريد بن عبد الله عن أبي بردة عن أبي موسى قال قال النبي

records.english: Qutaybah related to us, from Malik, from Sumayy, client of Abu Bakr, from Abu Salih al-Samman, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "While a man was walking along a road, he found a thorny branch on the road and moved it away. God appreciated his action and forgave him." Then he said: "The martyrs are five: one who dies of plague, one who dies of abdominal disease, one who drowns, one killed beneath a collapsed building, and one martyred in the path of God." He also said: "If people knew what there is in the call and the first row, and could find no way but drawing lots, they would draw lots for it. If they knew what there is in going early, they would race to it. If they knew what there is in the night and morning prayers, they would come to them even crawling."

records.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن حوشب قال حدثنا عبد الوهاب قال حدثنا حميد عن أنس قال قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يا بني سلمة ألا تحتسبون آثاركم وقال مجاهد في قوله ونكتب ما قدموا وآثارهم قال خطاهم وقال بن أبي مريم أخبرنا يحيى بن أيوب حدثني حميد حدثني أنس أن بني سلمة أرادوا أن يتحولوا عن منازلهم فينزلوا قريبا من النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال فكره رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يعروا فقال ألا تحتسبون آثاركم قال مجاهد خطاهم آثارهم أن يمشي في الأرض بأرجلهم
records.english: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hawshab related to us, saying: Abdulwahhab related to us, saying: Humayd related to us, from Anas, who said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "O Banu Salimah, will you not seek reward for your footsteps?" Mujahid said concerning His words, "We record what they have sent ahead and their traces": "Their steps." Ibn Abi Maryam said: Yahya ibn Ayyub informed us: Humayd related to me: Anas related to me that Banu Salimah wanted to leave their homes and settle near the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. He said: the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم disliked their leaving [the place] bare, and said: "Will you not seek reward for your footsteps?" Mujahid said: "Their steps are their traces: their walking on the earth with their feet." [The intended sense of “leaving bare” and its unexpressed object remain uncertain.]

records.english: Umar ibn Hafs related to us, saying: My father related to us, saying: al-Amash related to us, saying: Abu Salih related to me, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "No prayer is heavier upon the hypocrites than the dawn and night prayers. If they knew what there is in them, they would come to them even crawling. I considered ordering the caller to announce the beginning of prayer, then ordering a man to lead the people, then taking burning brands and burning over those who still do not come out to prayer."

records.english: Abdullah ibn Maslamah related to us, from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "The angels pray for each of you while he remains in his place of prayer, so long as he does not break his ablution: 'O God, forgive him; O God, have mercy on him.' Each of you remains in prayer as long as prayer keeps him there and nothing but prayer prevents him from returning to his family."

records.arabic: حدثنا محمد بن بشار قال حدثنا يحيى عن عبيد الله قال حدثني خبيب بن عبد الرحمن عن حفص بن عاصم عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال سبعة يظلهم الله في ظله يوم لا ظل إلا ظله الإمام العادل وشاب نشأ في عبادة ربه ورجل قلبه معلق في المساجد ورجلان تحابا في الله اجتمعا عليه وتفرقا عليه ورجل طلبته امرأة ذات منصب وجمال فقال إني أخاف الله ورجل تصدق أخفى حتى لا تعلم شماله ما تنفق يمينه ورجل ذكر الله خاليا ففاضت عيناه
records.english: Muhammad ibn Bashshar related to us, saying: Yahya related to us, from Ubaydullah, who said: Khubayb ibn Abdurrahman related to me, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, who said: "Seven will be shaded by God in His shade on a day when there is no shade except His shade: a just leader; a youth brought up worshipping his Lord; a man whose heart is attached to mosques; two men who love each other for God's sake, meeting and parting upon that; a man whom a woman of standing and beauty solicits, and who says, 'I fear God'; a man who gives charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand spends; and a man who remembers God alone and whose eyes overflow."
